info.title: asknget API
info.description:
Multi-vendor marketplace: buyer storefront, seller portal, admin.

**Base URL: every path in this document already starts with `/api/v1`, so a client's base URL is the origin only** (for example `https://asknget.co.za`), never `.../api/v1`.

Auth is `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Money is integer minor units (`*_cents`). Lists return `{items, total, page, per_page, pages}`. Every error is `{"detail": "..."}` (422 adds `errors[]`). `X-Region`, `X-Language`, `X-Timezone` (all calls), `X-Store` (seller calls) and `X-Cart-Token` (cart and checkout) are declared on the operations that use them.

Sales Analytics. `net_sales_cents` here is gross − discounts − refunds + adjustments
(the designer's definition; an adjustment is signed, + is a credit to the seller), which is a
different quantity from the overview's net. Gross counts every paid line, including ones later
cancelled or returned; refunds takes those back out (net of their share of any voucher).

XRegion.name: X-Region
XRegion.description: Market (country code, e.g. ZA or PK). Unknown or inactive is 400 unknown_region. Without it the market comes from the host's subdomain, then the default country. Send it on every call: a frontend behind a proxy never has a country subdomain.

XLanguage.name: X-Language
XLanguage.description: The user's saved language (a code from GET /regions, e.g. en or ur). Otherwise Accept-Language, then the market's default.

XTimezone.name: X-Timezone
XTimezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Asia/Karachi. Otherwise the market's timezone.

XStore.name: X-Store
XStore.description: Seller calls only: which store, when the signed-in person belongs to several (own store first, else the first joined). A store that is not theirs is 403 no_active_store.

XCartToken.name: X-Cart-Token
XCartToken.description: Guest carts: the cart_token returned by the first POST /cart/items; send it back on every cart and checkout call. Members can omit it; signing in merges the guest cart into the account cart.
